articles.summary: NioCorp is pleased to announce that the Export-Import Bank of the United States has featured the Company's Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project in southeast Nebraska as part of EXIM's Factory Floor Fridays initiative, highlighting the pivotal role Elk Creek will prospectively play in strengthening domestic critical mineral supply chains and supporting American manufacturing.
articles.title: U.S. Export-Import Bank Features NioCorp’s Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project in EXIM’s Factory Floor Fridays Initiative
